purpose: Canonical runtime contract for the 24-week Learn -> Apply -> Check -> Evidence learning engine.

completionRule.learn: Learner reviews the lesson objective, core concepts, and senior takeaway.
completionRule.apply: Learner records application notes covering decisions, assumptions, output, and verification approach.
completionRule.check: Learner submits every knowledge-check question; a passing score is required before the stage can be marked complete.
completionRule.evidence: Learner records identifiable, sanitized evidence with contribution, reasoning, and reviewability; saving evidence also creates the Portfolio record.

skillSignalRule: Evidence should update only the skills explicitly listed in the module skillSignals map; no global skill inflation from generic completion.

weeks.title: MicroStation CONNECT fundamentals & level structures
weeks.portfolioTarget: MicroStation level and drafting setup evidence

weeks.title: Single line diagrams: reading and producing

uiContract.course: Selecting a stage must render the week-specific curriculum payload, not the generic fallback when a payload exists.
uiContract.home: Next Best Action must resolve to the first incomplete stage across the 24-week sequence.
uiContract.skills: Show evidence-backed skill signals separately from manually adjusted skill ratings.
uiContract.journal: A saved reflection remains a journal record and contributes to weekly hours/streak independently of course completion.
uiContract.portfolio: Every saved guided evidence record is shown as a portfolio item with week, title, description, and reference.
